latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Generator Free Cartoon 1.0.0

- Initial release: generate cartoon-style animated videos from text prompts in 1-2 minutes, no animation skills required.
- Supports file uploads (MP4, MOV, WebM, GIF, up to 500MB) and creates videos server-side via cloud GPU backend.
- Simple onboarding: auto-connects via free anonymous token (NEMO_TOKEN) and manages rendering sessions.
- Exposes actions for upload, generate (via SSE), export, check credits, and view session state.
- Detailed error handling and user-friendly feedback for common actions and issues.
- Ideal for content creators, educators, and social media users seeking an easy way to make cartoon videos for free.
